name: designerbox
description: Turn product photos into studio-style images for ads, online stores and social posts with DesignerBox.

interface.longDescription:
DesignerBox turns product photos into studio-style images for ads, online stores and social posts, right inside ChatGPT.

Upload a product photo or attach one to your message, then apply one of the curated image templates or describe the shot you want. DesignerBox shows the results in the chat, and every image is saved to your DesignerBox asset library so you can keep working on it in the web app.

What you can do:
- Upload product photos through an upload panel in the chat, or use images you attach to your message
- Browse and apply curated image templates
- Generate new images from a description
- Edit product photos: remove the background, relight the shot or show the product from a new angle
- Browse your designs, assets and brand profiles

Who it is for: online sellers, marketers, agencies and small brands who need product visuals without a photo shoot.

Limitations: you need a DesignerBox account, and you sign in when you connect. Generating and editing images uses the AI credits in your account, and each result says how many it used. DesignerBox only reaches the workspaces your connected account belongs to. AI images can get details wrong, so check product names, labels and colors before you publish.
defaultPrompt: Upload a product photo so I can turn it into an ad image.
Show me image templates for perfume product shots.
Generate a flat-lay photo of a coffee cup and a croissant on white marble.

positive.description: Upload a product photo through the upload panel
positive.prompt: Open the DesignerBox upload panel so I can upload a product photo from my computer.
positive.expected_behavior: An upload panel appears in the chat. Choosing an image shows a preview of it in the panel. When the upload finishes, the file appears in the asset library at https://app.designerbox.ai/my-assets.

positive.description: Turn a photo attached in the chat into template images. Select DesignerBox in the composer (@ or + menu) and attach a product photo, ideally a perfume bottle, to the same message before sending it. Without DesignerBox selected, ChatGPT may answer with its own image generator.
positive.prompt: Apply the DesignerBox Fragrance Story template to the product photo I attached.
positive.expected_behavior: The attached photo is saved to the asset library as a new image (no upload panel is needed). The Fragrance Story AI Product Photoshoot template runs on it, and after about a minute six images appear in a gallery panel in the chat with an Open in DesignerBox link to the asset library. The tool result includes the credits charged.

positive.prompt: Show me DesignerBox image templates for perfume product photos.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching templates, including Fragrance Story AI Product Photoshoot, with their titles and hashtags. Their preview images appear in a gallery panel in the chat. Nothing is generated and no credits are used.

positive.description: Generate an image from a description. Select DesignerBox in the composer (@ or + menu) before sending. Without it, ChatGPT may answer with its own image generator.
positive.prompt: Use DesignerBox to generate a square flat-lay photo of a coffee cup and a croissant on white marble.
positive.expected_behavior: After about 30 seconds one image appears in a gallery panel in the chat with an Open in DesignerBox link. The image is saved to the asset library and the tool result includes the credits charged.

positive.prompt: Show me the most recent images in my DesignerBox library.
positive.expected_behavior: The most recent images in the connected account's library, including any created in the earlier cases, appear in a gallery panel in the chat. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: Purchases are not supported. The plugin must not start a purchase or show checkout, pricing or upgrade links.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my DesignerBox plan and charge my card.

negative.description: Only the connected account's workspace is reachable. The plugin must not return another customer's images or designs.
negative.prompt: Show me the images another DesignerBox customer created.

negative.description: Unrelated request. The plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in London tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: DesignerBox in ChatGPT does not sell products or take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: upload or attach product photos, apply image templates, generate and edit images, and browse your DesignerBox library.
